Bundesliga (the list as first published in July 2026). A match moved after that is not followed. Calendar dates, kick off times and every match result are simulated. Example: Everton start at home to Crystal Palace, then visit Bournemouth. Take a club over part way through that first season and the weeks before you were played in the real order too. Other leagues, custom clubs, edited worlds, older saves, later seasons and a club you move to during a season keep generated fixtures. Your Calendar names the two sources for your league.
